You: What is this slab used for?
Torr: It used to match shifts with maintenance crews. Today we leave notes for each other. Ask around the hill before you trust a blank screen.
Linn: Looking for someone? Try the shade. Sooner or later everyone comes up here, even the people who swear they are too busy.
You: Why does everyone meet here?
Linn: You can see the gate, hear the market, and get out of the dust. No terminal needs to explain that. If we get separated, meet me on the hill.
Mira: Welcome to Basic General. Fresh seals on the flasks, checked packs in the medkits. I can buy that scrap coil if you need a few credits.
You: Show me your stock.

# Third-party asset credits and licences

## Athen Hill soundscape — ElevenLabs

"Hill at Dusk" instrumental music and twelve sound-effect assets were generated
for this project with ElevenLabs on 8 September 2026, using the project's account.
Music: music_v2. Sound effects: eleven_text_to_sound_v2. Original prompts describe
the colony setting and do not reference an existing soundtrack or artist.
The game uses edited, level-balanced versions with prepared loop boundaries.
Original responses, prompts and hashes are retained in
unity/staging/elevenlabs-audio/manifest.json and the adjacent source records.
Generated outputs are subject to the account's ElevenLabs terms.

These notices cover the sources used to author Athen Hill's replacement
colonist. Keep this notice with distributions containing the derived assets.
Original source files, pack metadata and file hashes are retained in the
repository under `blender/sources/`.

## Elvaerwyn — Grump hair

**Grump hair (`elvs_grump_hair`) by Elvaerwyn, used under Creative Commons
Attribution (CC-BY).**

- [Original asset entry](https://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/2796)
- [Official Hair 02 pack and licence listing](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/hair02.html)
- [Creative Commons licence information](https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/cclicenses/)

Changes for Athen Hill: fitted to the colonist's head and rig, reduced the
raised crest, changed the colour and material response, reduced mesh density
in Blender, and prepared the result for glTF. The original source header and
pack manifest specify `CC-BY` without a version; this notice preserves that
designation. No creator endorsement is implied.

## MakeHuman Community / MPFB

Human anatomy, morph targets, rig and weights, `middleage_caucasian_male`
skin, low-poly eyes and their materials, and eyebrow001 cards are MakeHuman
Community graphical assets under **CC0 1.0 Universal**. They were imported
using MPFB 2.0.17, fitted and adapted for the colonist. The graphical-asset
licence is separate from the MPFB add-on's GPLv3 source-code licence.

- [MakeHuman/MPFB licence statement](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html)
- [Official system asset pack](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html)
- [MPFB 2.0.17 source](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2/tree/v2.0.17)
- [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

## grinsegold — Beard Sigmund WIP

**Beard Sigmund WIP by grinsegold**, fitted and recoloured for Athen Hill.
The current official [Bodyparts 05 pack](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/bodyparts05.html)
and its retained per-asset manifest declare **CC0**.
[Original asset entry](https://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/877).

The original `.mhclo` file also contains a legacy MakeClothes-generated
`AGPL3` header. That header is retained unchanged alongside the current CC0
pack metadata. The project's sourcing basis is the current official CC0
declaration; the discrepant historical notice is preserved here explicitly.

## Mindfront — Aksel skin normal map

**Aksel skin by Mindfront**, **CC0** in the official
[Skins 02 pack](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html).
[Original asset entry](https://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/850).

Only `Aksel_Skin_NRM.png` is used in the selected skin material, at a reduced
normal strength of 0.22. The Aksel diffuse albedo was rejected; the selected
diffuse skin is the MakeHuman system skin credited above.

## Poly Haven texture contributors

- [Blue Metal Plate](https://polyhaven.com/a/blue_metal_plate): normal detail
  and diffuse-derived neutral wear for the olive armour. A source roughness
  map is retained, although the selected metal material uses constant roughness.
- [Fabric Leather 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/fabric_leather_01): normal and
  roughness detail for dark suit and gear materials.

Both are **CC0**, as stated in [Poly Haven's asset licence](https://polyhaven.com/license).
The project adjusts UV scale, normal strength and material response; the
metal diffuse is adapted into a neutral wear texture using Blender. Original
downloaded maps are preserved in the source archive.

## Retained audition sources

RehmanPolanski's [Viking beard and moustache](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/bodyparts05.html)
are CC0 and remain in the authoring source archive. They were auditioned and
replaced by the Sigmund beard in the selected character. No paid model is
included. Athen Hill's armour geometry and faction markings are original
project work; the character is not an extracted commercial-game asset.


## Original city audio

Wind/market bed, stone footsteps, terminal confirmation and transport hum: supplied
ElevenLabs-generated, level-adjusted mixes. No music or recorded voice set is included.

Distribution note: Original generated prompts; account-specific distribution terms have not been independently reviewed. No third-party music or character voices requested.

Generation and source QA records are retained in public/assets/audio/ in the repository.

## Meshy mission terminal

The mission-terminal model was generated for Athen Hill with Meshy Multi-Image
to 3D on 8 September 2026 from original project concept art. Meshy task and
generation settings are retained beside the source model in
`meshy/mission-terminal-v1/model/meshy-manifest.json`. The game imports the
textured GLB and uses three instances of that one asset.


Meshy salvage and civic rebuilding pass — 2026-09-08
Original reference sheets were generated for Athen Hill using OpenAI image generation; Relay Works reuses the project’s accepted reference sheet. Eight textured static assets were generated with Meshy 7 multi-image-to-3d: relay, general, hall, billboard, crate, generator, trash, scrap. Task IDs, input-view provenance, face counts and SHA-256 digests are recorded in meshy/salvage-20260908/manifest.json. Source FBX/GLB and textures are retained there. No extracted commercial-game assets were used.

## Colony UI · September 2026

The illustrated flask, medkit, lattice cube, pack, field notebook and salvage coil
were generated as original UI artwork using OpenAI image generation. Full prompts
and source images are retained in refs/ui_20260908/items. The frame, Free Column
insignia and interface symbols are original SVG artwork authored for this project.

UI typography uses Liberation Sans Narrow, Copyright 2007–2011 Red Hat, Inc.
and Copyright 2010 Oracle and/or its affiliates.
The font is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 2, with the
font embedding exception. The full supplied licence and notices are retained in
Assets/AthenHill/UI/Art/FONT-LICENSE.txt.
